hooks.name: lint-and-test
hooks.description: On save of any *.py file, run venv ruff on the file and venv pytest for its top-level folder (ml/, tests/, or backend/).

action.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && FILE=$(.venv/bin/python -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('filePath') or d.get('file') or d.get('path') or (d.get('payload') or {}).get('filePath') or '')"); [ -z "$FILE" ] && { echo "no file path in hook payload"; exit 0; }; REL=${FILE#"$PWD/"}; TOP=${REL%%/*}; echo "lint+test for $REL (folder: $TOP)"; .venv/bin/ruff check "$FILE"; case "$TOP" in ml) .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q ml;; tests) .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests;; backend) .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests backend;; *) echo "no top-level test folder for $TOP; skipping pytest";; esac
